description: The chart illustrates the distribution of a variable across different ranges, with the horizontal axis representing the range of values from 0.0 to 1.0 and the vertical axis labeled "Percentage" indicating the proportion of data points within each range. The horizontal axis is divided into five categories, although not explicitly labeled, and the vertical axis has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart features five light blue bars, each representing a category, with the first bar spanning from 0.0 to 0.2 and having a value of 11.2%, the second and third bars having equal values of 3.4% and spanning from 0.2 to 0.4 and 0.4 to 0.6, respectively, the fourth bar having a value of 5.8% and spanning from 0.6 to 0.8, and the fifth bar having a value of 76.2% and spanning from 0.8 to 1.0. A red dashed line is drawn at 0.82 on the horizontal axis, annotated with "mean: 0.82" in red text, indicating the mean value of the distribution. The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than by their corresponding range on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the representation of the mean.
